```sql
  AND ST_Intersects(lake.geometry::geography, (SELECT regions.geometry::geography FROM regions WHERE regions.region_name ILIKE '%Saguache%' AND regions.addr_state = 'Colorado' LIMIT 1));
```

```sql
SELECT SUM(ST_Length(geometry::geography)) AS total_canal_length
FROM lakes
WHERE waterway = 'canal'
  AND ST_Intersects(geometry::geography, (SELECT geometry FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE '%Payson%' LIMIT 1));
```

```sql
SELECT SUM(ST_Length(roads.geometry::geography)) AS total_road_length
FROM roads
WHERE ST_Intersects(roads.geometry, (SELECT regions.geometry FROM regions WHERE regions.region_name ILIKE '%Rio Grande%' AND regions.border_type = 'county' LIMIT 1));
```
